left_out: the notes don't explain it: The notes given do not explain what tossing a sandal over Edom means. Calvin only gives the verse text, Keil and Delitzsch only discuss Hebrew wording and the shout of joy over Philistia, and Matthew Henry only says David claims the lands and the necks of his enemies as promised by God. None of them says whether the sandal means a slave, taking possession, or trampling, so any meaning would have to come from outside the notes.
